t: This is the Courtauld Institute of Art, a self-governing college of the University of London that specialises in the history of art and conservation. It was founded by Samuel Courtauld, an English industrialist who is best remembered as an art collector. He set it up in 1932. After a series of gifts during the 1930s, he left his collection to the institute when he died in 1947. So the art and the institution come from the same person.
